200.description:
Describe one dataset on a Socrata portal: every column (field name used in SoQL, display name, Socrata type, description), exact row count (count(*)), category, tags, attribution, license, provenance, creation/publication/last-update timestamps and portal-defined metadata such as update frequency or owning department. The portal must be a Socrata domain (else invalid_input not_socrata_portal); an unknown or private dataset id is not_found.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `api_url` | string |  |
| `asset_type` | string | dataset, filter, map, chart, file, href... |
| `attribution` | string |  |
| `attribution_link` | string |  |
| `category` | string |  |
| `column_count` | number |  |
| `columns` | object[] |  |
| `created_at` | string | ISO 8601. |
| `custom_fields` | object[] | Portal-defined metadata (update frequency, owner department, time period...), at most 40. |
| `description` | string | Plain text, HTML removed, cut at 4000 characters. |
| `id` | string |  |
| `license` | object |  |
| `metadata_url` | string | The views API request issued. |
| `name` | string |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `permalink` | string |  |
| `portal` | string |  |
| `provenance` | string | official or community. |
| `publication_date` | string | ISO 8601. |
| `row_count` | number | Exact count(*) of rows for tabular datasets; null for non-tabular assets. |
| `rows_updated_at` | string | ISO 8601, last data update. |
| `tags` | string[] |  |
| `view_last_modified` | string | ISO 8601, last metadata update. |
| `view_type` | string | tabular for row data; only tabular assets can be queried. |

group.description: SoQL $group, e.g. `permit_type` (with an aggregate in select).

limit.description:
Rows per page (1-1000). A page is also cut at about 1 MB of row data; continue from next_offset.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 1000; default 100.

Provider reference: minimum 0; maximum 100000000; default 0.

order.description: SoQL $order, e.g. `issue_date DESC`. Defaults to the row id `:id` for stable paging (none for aggregates).

q.description: Full-text search across the dataset's text columns.

select.description: SoQL $select without the keyword: columns, aliases, aggregates. E.g. `permit_, permit_type, issue_date` or `permit_type, count(*) AS n`.

where.description: SoQL $where without the keyword. String literals in single quotes ('O''Hare' escapes a quote). E.g. `issue_date >= '2024-01-01' AND permit_type = 'PERMIT - NEW CONSTRUCTION'`, `within_circle(location, 41.88, -87.63, 500)`.

200.description:
Query rows of a dataset on any Socrata portal through its SODA 2.1 endpoint with SoQL: select (columns, aliases, aggregates), where (comparisons, like, between, in, date and spatial functions), order, group and full-text q, paged with limit (1-1000) and offset. Rows come back as published (numbers and dates as strings, geometry as GeoJSON) with the returned field names and types; pages are cut at about 1 MB of row data with next_offset to continue. The portal must be a Socrata domain (else invalid_input not_socrata_portal); an unknown dataset is not_found; SoQL the portal rejects (unknown column, syntax) is invalid_input at the offending field; an empty page is a successful result.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `rows` as the primary payload key.

The provider does not publish a field list for this tool.

200.description:
Search the Socrata catalog for datasets, across every public Socrata portal in a region or limited to one portal (`domain`), by free text, category and tags, paged with limit/offset (up to 100 per page). Each dataset has its 4x4 id, name, owning portal domain, plain-text description, category, tags, attribution, license, created/updated dates, the column field names and types, popularity, permalink and SODA API URL. A domain that no Socrata region serves fails with invalid_input not_socrata_portal; a search with no matches is a successful empty result.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `datasets` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `api_url` | string | SODA 2.1 endpoint https://<domain>/resource/<id>.json |
| `attribution` | string | Publishing agency as stated by the portal. |
| `category` | string | The portal's own category (domain_category), else Socrata's global category. |
| `column_count` | number |  |
| `columns` | object[] | Every column as field_name (the SoQL identifier), display name and Socrata type, in catalog order (not table order). |

| `data_updated_at` | string | ISO 8601, last data change. |

| `license` | string |  |
| `name` | string |  |
| `page_views_total` | number |  |
| `permalink` | string | https://<domain>/d/<id> |
